availability: At current chart publication only; never use later rows for debut predictions

definitions.chart_first4w_points_after_window: Sum 101-rank over all source rows in [debut,debut+28 days); visible only on chart dates >=debut+28 days
definitions.chart_prior_absent_chart_count: Number of intervening source chart dates with no appearance; first appearance null
definitions.chart_rank_improvement_per_elapsed_week: (previous best observed rank - current best rank) / elapsed days*7; positive means improvement; first appearance null

duplicate_rule: Rank minimum per song/date, points include every source row; final output retains every source location
